look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Upper opposite round scalloped leaves clasp the square stem; lower leaves have stalks. Pink tubular two-lipped flowers cluster at upper nodes.
taxonomy_notes: POWO accepted species. Do not make separate cards for its synonyms.

project_inclusion.notes: Introduced encounter species; no invasive claim.

morphology_keys.habit: Cool-season annual herb with square stems.
morphology_keys.leaves_attachment: Opposite crenate leaves, upper sessile and clasping, lower petiolate.
morphology_keys.flower_reproductive: Pink-purple bilabiate tubular corollas in axillary verticillasters.

confused_with: Lamium purpureum: more pointed and usually stalked upper leaves.
Glechoma hederacea: creeping perennial with stalked leaves.
comparisons.key_distinctions: Clasping upper leaf pairs and tubular two-lipped flowers.
